questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "CANDID"

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "CANDID"

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "DILIGENT"

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "DILIGENT"
questions.explanation: DILIGENT (परिश्रमी) का Antonym है Lazy (आलसी) या Indolent.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "ELOQUENT"
questions.explanation: ELOQUENT का अर्थ होता है वाकपटु, सुवक्ता या प्रभावकारी। Synonym: Fluent, Expressive, Articulate.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "ELOQUENT"
questions.explanation: ELOQUENT (वाकपटु) का Antonym है Inarticulate (अस्पष्ट/अवाक) या Unexpressive.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "GARRULOUS"
questions.explanation: GARRULOUS का अर्थ होता है बातूनी या वाचाल। Synonym: Talkative, Voluble, Loquacious.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "GARRULOUS"
questions.explanation: GARRULOUS (बातूनी) का Antonym है Reticent (कम बोलने वाला) या Silent.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A decision, law or action that cannot be recalled, revoked or changed"

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who is unable to pay off his financial debts or loans"
questions.explanation: ऋण न चुका पाने वाले दिवालिया व्यक्ति को Insolvent या Bankrupt कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who collects or is intensely interested in postage stamps"
questions.explanation: डाक टिकटों के संग्रहकर्ता को Philatelist कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who collects or studies coins, medals and tokens"

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who loves, collects or reads books with passion"
questions.explanation: पुस्तकों के प्रेमी को Bibliophile कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Break the ice"
options: Make people feel more comfortable in a conversation
questions.explanation: Break the ice = चुप्पी तोड़ना, बातचीत सहज बनाना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Burn the midnight oil"
options: To sleep late in the morning
Work or study late into the night
questions.explanation: Burn the midnight oil = देर रात तक मेहनत करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Bite the bullet"
options: Face a hard situation with bravery and patience
questions.explanation: Bite the bullet = कठिन परिस्थिति का हिम्मत से सामना करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Call it a day"
options: Stop working on a task for the rest of the day
questions.explanation: Call it a day = उस दिन के लिए काम बंद करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Cry over spilt milk"
options: Complain or regret about a past loss that cannot be fixed
questions.explanation: Cry over spilt milk = व्यर्थ में पछताना।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "He is senior than me in the office."
questions.explanation: Rule: Senior के साथ प्रपोजिशन 'to' आता है (senior to me).

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "Neither the chairman nor the directors was present."
questions.explanation: Rule: Neither...nor में निकटतम सब्जेक्ट ('directors' प्लुरल) के अनुसार Plural Verb 'were' आएगी।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "She is working here since five years."
questions.explanation: Rule: समय की अवधि ('five years') के लिए 'has been working for five years' आएगा।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He died _____ cancer after a long illness."
questions.explanation: Rule: बीमारी से मृत्यु होने पर 'die of' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "She prefers tea _____ coffee in the morning."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Prefer' के साथ प्रपोजिशन 'to' आता है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He was accused _____ theft by the police."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Accuse' के साथ हमेशा 'of' आता है (accused of theft).

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A system of government run by unelected civil officials"
questions.explanation: नौकरशाही को Bureaucracy कहते हैं।

questions.explanation: Face the music = परिणाम भुगतना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Hit the nail on the head"

questions.explanation: Hit the nail on the head = सटीक बात कहना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "In the nick of time"
options: Just in time at the last moment
questions.explanation: In the nick of time = ठीक समय पर।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "Hardly had he left <u>than</u> the rain started."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Hardly' के साथ कंजंक्शन 'when' प्रयुक्त होता है।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "If I <u>was</u> you, I would accept the offer."
questions.explanation: Rule: काल्पनिक वाक्य में Subject के साथ 'were' आता है।

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "He wrote a letter."
options: A letter was written by him.
A letter has been written by him.
A letter is written by him.
A letter was being written by him.
questions.explanation: Past Simple का Passive = Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "They are playing football."
options: Football has been played by them.
Football is being played by them.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous का Passive = Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: He said, "I am going to market."
options: He asked if he was going to market.
He said that he was going to market.
He said that I am going to market.
He told that he is going to market.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous बदलकर Past Continuous (was going) बनता है।

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: She said to me, "What is your name?"
options: She asked me what my name was.
She asked me what is my name.
She asked me what was my name.
She told me what my name is.
questions.explanation: WH- question का Indirect = asked + me + what my name was.
